outlooks.summary: AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT ALONG WITH POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE TORNADOES IS FORECAST THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS THE UPPER OHIO VALLEY INTO THE SOUTHERN TO CENTRAL APPALACHIAN MOUNTAINS AND EASTWARD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES. SEVERE STORMS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHERN PLAINS. MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS WITH HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY ALSO OCCUR ACROSS THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY...MID MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...CENTRAL TO EASTERN GULF COAST STATES AND CAROLINAS.

sections.title: UPPER OH VALLEY/SRN AND CNTRL APPALACHIANS/MID-ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE SEWD FROM THE GREAT LAKES REGION INTO THE UPPER OH VALLEY TODAY. AT THE SFC...A LOW WILL MOVE SEWD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AS A COLD FRONT ADVANCES SEWD INTO THE SRN AND CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS. A MOIST AIRMASS WILL BE IN PLACE AHEAD OF THE TRACK OF THE SFC LOW WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS MUCH OF THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION BY EARLY AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORMS APPEAR LIKELY TO FIRST INITIATE AROUND LAKE ERIE AROUND MIDDAY WITH A LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM ORGANIZING AND MOVING SEWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS DURING THE AFTERNOON. THIS CONVECTION MAY REACH THE MID-ATLANTIC COAST DURING THE EVENING OR OVERNIGHT PERIOD. CONCERNING THE SEVERE THREAT...BOTH THE NAM AND GFS SOLUTIONS ARE IN AGREEMENT WITH THE PLACEMENT OF AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY...EXTENDING FROM NRN VA NWWD INTO SW PA BY EARLY AFTERNOON. LOOKING AT NAM AND RAP FORECAST SOUNDINGS ALONG THIS CORRIDOR AT 21Z...SFC DEWPOINTS SHOULD BE IN THE MID 60S IN THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS WITH LOWER 70S F POSSIBLE IN THE LOWER ELEVATIONS OF THE MID-ATLANTIC. THIS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES REACHING 1500 TO 2000 J/KG BY MID-AFTERNOON WITH CONSIDERABLE DCAPE. THE W

sections.title: NRN PLAINS/MID MO VALLEY
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE WILL BUILD NNEWD ACROSS THE MID MO VALLEY AND UPPER MS VALLEY TODAY AS SOUTHWEST MID-LEVEL FLOW BECOMES ESTABLISHED ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS. AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY IS FORECAST TO BE IN PLACE BY LATE AFTERNOON FROM ERN NEB NWD INTO THE CNTRL DAKOTAS WHERE ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS APPEAR LIKELY TO DEVELOP DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON. SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS MAY PERSIST INTO THE EARLY TO MID EVENING ACROSS THE ERN DAKOTAS. RAP FORECAST SOUNDINGS ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS AT 22Z SHOW AN IMPRESSIVE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILE WITH MLCAPE OF 3000 TO 3500 J/KG WITH 700 TO 500 MB LAPSE RATES OF 8.5 C/KM. THIS COMBINED WITH 25 TO 30 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR STRONG UPDRAFTS WITH ROTATION AND POSSIBLY SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH CONVECTION IN AREAS THAT DESTABILIZE THE MOST. VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER MAY ALSO CONTRIBUTE TO A WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL.

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY/CNTRL AND ERN GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: NORTHWEST MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY FROM THE MID MS VALLEY SEWD INTO THE ERN GULF COAST STATES. AT THE SFC...A MOIST AIRMASS SHOULD BE LOCATED ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F. IN RESPONSE TO SFC HEATING...MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP ACROSS A LARGE AREA WITH THE GREATEST INSTABILITY LOCATED FROM NRN AR SEWD ACROSS NRN MS INTO CNTRL AL AND CNTRL GA. THUNDERSTORMS THAT DEVELOP ALONG THIS CORRIDOR OF INSTABILITY DURING THE MID TO LATE AFTERNOON WILL HAVE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.

sections.title: WEST TX
sections.text: SOUTHWEST MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS. THE WRN EDGE OF A MOIST AIRMASS SHOULD BE LOCATED ACROSS WEST TX NEAR THE ERN EDGE OF AN ELEVATED MIXED LAYER. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS WEST TX AT 00Z/FRI SHOW SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F WITH MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 1500 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE. THIS COMBINED WITH DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE LOW TO MID-LEVELS AND 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES NEAR 8.0 C/KM SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT WITH HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS POSSIBLE. ..BROYLES/PICCA.. 06/16/2016

outlooks.summary: AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT ALONG WITH POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE TORNADOES IS FORECAST THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS THE UPPER OHIO VALLEY INTO THE SOUTHERN TO CENTRAL APPALACHIAN MOUNTAINS AND EASTWARD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES. OTHER ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHERN PLAINS.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE DAKOTAS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE SOUTHEAST AND MID ATLANTIC REGION...

sections.title: UPPER OH VALLEY INTO MID ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: MORNING WATER VAPOR LOOP SHOWS A WELL-DEFINED SHORTWAVE TROUGH NEAR MKE. THIS FEATURE WILL TRACK RAPIDLY SOUTHEASTWARD AND AFFECT PARTS OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY AND MID ATLANTIC REGION THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. THIS WILL RESULT IN SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY EARLY AFTERNOON OVER PARTS OF EASTERN OH. STRENGTHENING LOW/MID LEVEL WIND FIELDS IN THIS REGION WILL HELP TO ORGANIZE STORMS INTO BOWING/SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO. STORMS WILL PROGRESS ACROSS PARTS OF WV/PA AND EVENTUALLY INTO VA EARLY THIS EVENING. A CONSENSUS OF OVERNIGHT CAM SOLUTIONS SHOW A RELATIVELY FAST-MOVING BOWING COMPLEX TRAVERSING THE ENHANCED RISK AREA...POSING THE RISK OF RELATIVELY WIDESPREAD WIND DAMAGE. CONSIDERABLE UNCERTAINTY IS PRESENT REGARDING HOW FAR SOUTHWEST THE STORMS WILL DEVELOP ACROSS WV/EASTERN KY/SOUTHWEST VA. WILL MAINTAIN THE SLIGHT RISK IN THIS REGION AND DEFER TO LATER OUTLOOKS TO RE-EVALUATE IF STORMS ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP THIS FAR SOUTHWEST.

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: AN UPPER RIDGE AXIS EXTENDS FROM KS INTO THE EASTERN DAKOTAS...WITH SUBTLE MID LEVEL HEIGHT RISES EXPECTED TODAY ACROSS THE NORTHERN PLAINS. DESPITE LIMITED LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT...SOUTHWESTERLY MID LEVEL WINDS WILL INCREASE ON THE BACK SIDE OF THE RIDGE OVER THE DAKOTAS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP AROUND DUSK OVER PARTS OF SD AND SPREAD NORTHWARD INTO ND. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND CAPE TO SUPPORT A RISK OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL IN THE STRONGEST STORMS.

sections.title: EASTERN CENTRAL PLAINS INTO SOUTHEAST
sections.text: A BROAD AREA OF MODERATE CAPE IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP TODAY FROM NEB SOUTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF THE TN VALLEY AND AL. FORCING MECHANISMS ARE SUBTLE AND UNCERTAIN THROUGHOUT THIS REGION...BUT VARIOUS CAM SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THE RISK OF ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY. ANY STORM THAT FORMS WOULD POSE A RISK OF LOCALLY GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS DUE TO STRONG INSTABILITY AND STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES. THIS THREAT SHOULD END QUICKLY AFTER SUNSET.

sections.title: WEST TX
sections.text: A MOIST AND VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IS EXPECTED ONCE AGAIN TODAY OVER PARTS OF WEST TX. WATER VAPOR LOOP DOES NOT SUGGEST ANY DISCERNIBLE FORCING MECHANISMS APPROACHING THIS AREA...SUGGESTING THAT ANY CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT WOULD BE TIED STRONGLY TO DAYTIME HEATING AND WOULD BE WEAKLY ORGANIZED. FOR THESE REASONS...HAVE OPTED TO REMOVE THE MARGINAL RISK AREA IN THIS REGION. LATER OUTLOOKS WILL CONTINUE TO EVALUATE WEST TX FOR RISING CONFIDENCE THAT A PARTICULAR AREA MIGHT SEE CONVECTIVE INITIATION...AND POSSIBLY RE-INSERT A MARGINAL RISK AREA. ..HART/LEITMAN.. 06/16/2016

outlooks.summary: AN ENHANCED WIND-DAMAGE THREAT ALONG WITH POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE TORNADOES IS FORECAST THIS AFTERNOON FROM THE UPPER OHIO VALLEY AND CENTRAL/SOUTHERN APPALACHIAN MOUNTAINS EASTWARD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES. OTHER ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHERN PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A GENERAL WRN TROUGH/CENTRAL RIDGE/ERN TROUGH PATTERN ALOFT WILL PREVAIL THIS PERIOD...WITH LITTLE OVERALL MOVEMENT TO THE LARGE SCALE PATTERN EXPECTED. AT SMALLER SCALES HOWEVER...A COMPACT/POTENT VORT MAX NOW CENTERED OVER LOWER MI --ON THE BACK SIDE OF THE LARGER-SCALE ERN TROUGH -- WILL DIG SEWD WITH TIME...CROSSING THE MID AND UPPER OH VALLEY/CENTRAL AND SRN APPALACHIANS REGIONS AND EVENTUALLY REACHING THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. A SURFACE LOW AND TRAILING COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS VORT MAX IS ALSO FORECAST TO SHIFT SEWD ACROSS THE MID AND UPPER OH VALLEY/CENTRAL APPALACHIANS DURING THE AFTERNOON...WITH THE LOW PROGGED TO MOVE/REDEVELOP E OF THE MOUNTAINS BY EARLY EVENING. FARTHER W...A COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE WRN U.S. UPPER TROUGH WILL MAKE GRADUAL EWD PROGRESS ACROSS THE CANADIAN PRAIRIE AND THE ADJACENT U.S. NRN PLAINS THROUGH THIS EVENING/OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: CENTRAL AND SRN APPALACHIANS/MID-ATLANTIC VICINITY
sections.text: A BAND OF STORMS MOVING INTO CENTRAL PA HAS WEAKENED OVER THE PAST HOUR...WITH DENSE CLOUD COVER INTO THE MOUNTAINS LIMITING DOWNSTREAM DESTABILIZATION. HOWEVER...ON THE SWRN FRINGE OF THIS CLOUDINESS /INTO SWRN PA AND AREAS S AND W/...DIURNAL HEATING OF A MOIST /MID 60S TO LOW 70S DEWPOINTS/ BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT MODERATE TO STRONG DESTABILIZATION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AS THE VORT MAX AND ASSOCIATED SURFACE LOW/COOL FRONT SHIFTS SEWD ACROSS OH...A BAND OF STORMS IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP DURING THE AFTERNOON...WHICH SHOULD ORGANIZE/GROW UPSCALE INTO A BOWING MCS AND SHIFT QUICKLY SEWD ACROSS THE SRN PA/WV/MD AREA...AND INTO VA THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. GIVEN 35 TO 55 KT FLOW IN THE 850 TO 500 MB LAYER...EXPECT FAST STORM MOTIONS AND LIKELIHOOD FOR FAIRLY WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS. LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE...ALONG WITH A TORNADO OR TWO. STORMS SHOULD WEAKEN AS THEY MOVE TOWARD THE DELMARVA REGION AND MID-ATLANTIC COAST LATER IN THE EVENING...THOUGH SOME DAMAGING WIND RISK WILL LIKELY REACH THE COAST BEFORE STORMS MOVE OFFSHORE.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: GRADUAL ADVANCE OF A COLD FRONT EWD ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS INTO AN UNSTABLE -- BUT CAPPED -- AIRMASS ACROSS THE CENTRAL DAKOTAS BY EVENING SHOULD EVENTUALLY SUPPORT ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORM DEVELOPMENT. THOUGH OVERALL SEVERE RISK SHOULD REMAIN TEMPERED DUE TO WHAT SHOULD REMAIN A LIMITED NUMBER OF STORMS...THE UNSTABLE BACKGROUND ENVIRONMENT COMBINED WITH THE SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER SWLYS ALOFT EXTENDING AS FAR SEWD AS NWRN SD/S CENTRAL ND SUGGESTS THAT ANY STORMS WHICH DO DEVELOP WILL LIKELY ORGANIZE. AS SUCH...RISK FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE -- MAINLY DURING THE EVENING AND INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS -- ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE ND VICINITY.

sections.title: CENTRAL AND ERN GULF COAST REGION FROM SERN MS INTO NWRN FL
sections.text: A MOIST/DESTABILIZING AIRMASS IS IN PLACE ACROSS THE CENTRAL GULF COASTAL REGION THIS MORNING...WITH CU/CB DEVELOPMENT WIDESPREAD ACROSS THIS REGION. WITH AREA VWPS SHOWING FLOW VEERING THROUGH THE LOWER AND MID TROPOSPHERE FROM WLY TO NWLY AND INCREASING TO 25 TO 30 KT AT MID LEVELS...ORGANIZED MULTICELL STORMS -- POSSIBLY GROWING UPSCALE INTO ONE OR MORE SEWD-MOVING LINES OF CONVECTION -- APPEARS POSSIBLE...ALONG WITH ATTENDANT RISK FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL.

sections.title: MO/AR
sections.text: MCV/VORT MAX OVER ERN KS/MO ATTM IS FORECAST TO AID IN REDEVELOPMENT OF CONVECTION OVER SERN KS THIS AFTERNOON...WITHIN A MOIST AIRMASS WHICH WILL CONTINUE TO DESTABILIZE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. THOUGH FLOW ALOFT IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG /SGF MORNING RAOB SHOWING WNWLY FLOW AROUND 20 KT AT MID LEVELS/...EXPECT A LOOSELY ORGANIZED BAND OF STORMS TO EVOLVE DURING THE AFTERNOON AND SPREAD ESEWD ACROSS THE OZARKS VICINITY. A FEW STRONGER WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL CAN BE EXPECTED WITH THE MOST INTENSE UPDRAFTS. ..GOSS.. 06/16/2016

outlooks.summary: AN ENHANCED WIND-DAMAGE THREAT ALONG WITH POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE TORNADOES IS FORECAST THIS AFTERNOON FROM THE UPPER OHIO VALLEY AND CENTRAL/SOUTHERN APPALACHIAN MOUNTAINS EASTWARD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES. OTHER ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHERN PLAINS...AND REMAIN POSSIBLE INTO THE EARLY EVENING IN PORTIONS OF THE SOUTHEAST AND TENNESSEE VALLEY.

sections.title: WESTERN KY INTO NORTH-CENTRAL TN
sections.text: STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG A SOUTHWARD MOVING COLD FRONT ACROSS WESTERN KY...WHERE THE AIR MASS HAS BECOME VERY UNSTABLE PER RAP ANALYSIS WITH MLCAPE UP TO 3000-3500 J/KG. THIS REGION IS ALSO LIKELY BEING GLANCED WITH WEAK HEIGHT FALLS AS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH TRACKS TO THE SOUTHEAST INTO THE UPPER OH VALLEY AND CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. THESE FACTORS COMBINED WITH SOME INCREASE IN NWLY MID- TO UPPER-LEVEL WINDS/DEEP SHEAR SHOULD SUPPORT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE COLD FRONT...WITH AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS PRODUCING LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS AND/OR HAIL. THE MARGINAL SEVERE-WEATHER RISK WITH LOW SEVERE PROBABILITIES FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS HAS BEEN EXPANDED TO INCLUDE MUCH OF WESTERN KY INTO NORTH-CENTRAL TN. .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 305 PM CDT THU JUN 16 2016/ ...UPPER OH VALLEY TO MID-ATLANTIC STATES TO SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS... MINOR CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE SEVERE WEATHER RISK AREAS AND GENERAL TSTM OUTLOOK AREA WHERE EITHER THE COLD FRONT HAS MOVED THROUGH PORTIONS OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY AND/OR STORMS HAVE ALREADY STABILIZED THE AIR MASS /ACROSS NORTHEAST OH AND NORTHWEST PA/. OTHERWISE...NO CHANGES ARE NEEDED WITH THE ENHANCED SEVERE RIS

sections.title: SOUTHEAST STATES
sections.text: PORTIONS OF THE SLIGHT AND MARGINAL RISK AREAS HAVE BEEN LOWERED IN SEVERE PROBABILITIES AS STORMS HAVE STABILIZED PARTS OF THE REGION. OTHERWISE...THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS REMAINS ACROSS PARTS OF THE FL PANHANDLE AND SOUTHWEST GA...GIVEN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. THIS OUTLOOK HAS ADDED THE REST OF EAST-CENTRAL AL WHERE THE AIR MASS IS VERY UNSTABLE AND STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER NORTHEAST AL TRACKING TOWARD THE SOUTH. ..PETERS.. 06/16/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1238 PM CDT THU JUN 16 2016/

ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHERN PLAINS. MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS WITH HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR ACROSS PARTS OF THE MID MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...TENNESSEE VALLEY AND CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES.

sections.title: CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS/MID-ATLANTIC
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE UPPER OH VALLEY WITH A PRONOUNCED DRY SLOT EXTENDING EWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS. DOWNSTREAM OF THE DRY SLOT...A LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM IS ONGOING ACROSS NRN VA. AHEAD OF THE LINE...THE RAP IS ANALYZING MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS MOST OF VA. IN ADDITION...THE WSR-88D VWP AT ROANOKE SHOWS 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 50 KT WITH SPEED SHEAR IN THE MID-LEVELS AND GRADUALLY VEERING WINDS WITH HEIGHT. THIS COMBINED WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL CONTINUE TO BE FAVORABLE FOR A WIND DAMAGE THREAT ACROSS MUCH OF VA THIS EVENING. THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT SHOULD BE ACROSS CNTRL AND NRN VA AS THE STRONGEST PART OF THE LINE SEGMENT MOVES ESEWD ACROSS THAT AREA OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT COULD PERSIST THROUGH LATE EVENING IN PARTS OF NC AND FAR SE VA.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE FROM THE MID MO VALLEY NWD INTO WRN PARTS OF THE UPPER MS VALLEY WITH SOUTHWEST MID-LEVEL FLOW OVER MUCH OF THE GREAT PLAINS. AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY IS LOCATED FROM ERN NEB NNWWD INTO CNTRL SD AND CNTRL ND. THUNDERSTORMS ARE TRYING TO DEVELOP ALONG THE WRN EDGE OF THE INSTABILITY CORRIDOR BUT ARE STRUGGLING DUE TO A CAPPING INVERSION. SHORT-TERM MODELS SUGGEST THAT THE CAPPING INVERSION WILL EVENTUALLY WEAKEN...ALLOWING FOR SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS SRN AND CNTRL ND THIS EVENING. OTHER STORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP FURTHER TO THE EAST NEAR THE INSTABILITY AXIS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN SRN AND CNTRL ND THIS EVENING SHOW MODERATE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUGGESTING THAT STORM ROTATION MAY OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS ONCE CELLS CAN BECOME ESTABLISHED. A SUPERCELL OR TWO WITH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. THE MAJORITY OF THE CONVECTION SHOULD REMAIN MULTICELLULAR. LINE SEGMENTS MAY PRODUCE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: CNTRL GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A VERY MOIST AIRMASS IN PLACE FROM THE MID MS VALLEY SEWD ACROSS THE GULF COAST STATES WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE GENERALLY IN THE 70S F. THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY ACROSS A BROAD AREA. THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS PARTS OF NRN AND CNTRL AL. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD CONTINUE TO MOVE SWD INTO SCNTRL AL THIS EVENING. STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY SUPPORT A MARGINAL WIND DAMAGE THREAT FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO. ..BROYLES.. 06/17/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY FOR A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS AND OVER NRN VA E OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS INDICATES A STATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE FROM THE DELMARVA NWWD NEAR THE POTOMAC RIVER INTO WRN PA. THE AIRMASS S OF THE BOUNDARY IS CONTINUING TO DESTABILIZE LATE THIS MORNING WITH PATCHY CLOUD COVER. N OF THE BOUNDARY...WEAK CONVECTION AND ITS INCIPIENT CLOUD COVER OVER DE/NJ AND SERN PA HAVE THWARTED DESTABILIZATION FARTHER N OVER CNTRL PA SEWD INTO DE/SRN NJ. A BAND OF ELEVATED STORMS IS MOVING EWD ACROSS W-CNTRL PA AND WILL MOVE INTO A MORE HOSTILE AIRMASS FOR VIGOROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT. A 42-KT GUST WAS MEASURED AT KDUJ AROUND 15Z WITH THIS TSTM BAND. CURRENT THINKING IS ONLY A LOW RISK FOR WIND DAMAGE MAY EXIST WITH THIS ACTIVITY IN THE SHORT TERM. FARTHER SW...STORMS MAY BE TRANSITIONING TO SURFACE-BASED...AND A CONTINUED RISK FOR ISOLD LARGE HAIL MAY CONTINUE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS WELL AS AN INCREASING THREAT FOR STRONG/LOW-END SEVERE GUSTS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE. HOWEVER...THERE REMAINS UNCERTAINTY REGARDING ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER NRN WV NEAR THE SWRN PA STORMS. IF ADDITIONAL STORMS DEVELOP...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE CONSIDERED. OTHERWISE...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL PROBABLY NOT NEED TO BE CONSIDERED UNTIL LATER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR WIDESPREAD STRONG TO DMGG WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL WILL INCREASE OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS FROM ERN OH SEWD ACROSS SWRN PA AND NRN WV. THESE THREATS WILL EVENTUALLY EXTEND EWD ACROSS NRN VA AND MD LATER THIS AFTERNOON. A WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED BY 18-19Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED NEAR/SE OF CLEVELAND OVER THE PAST 1-2 HRS...ALONG WHAT APPEARS TO BE A PRE-FRONTAL WIND SHIFT EXTENDING SWWD INTO W-CNTRL OH. PRIMARY SFC LOW IS CENTERED OVER WRN LAKE ERIE...WITH COLD FRONT ENTERING NWRN OH AS OF 16Z. STRONG SFC HEATING IS OCCURRING ACROSS CNTRL AND ERN OH AHEAD OF THE DEVELOPING CONVECTION...AND UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S F DEWPOINTS ARE CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE VALUES LIKELY APPROACHING 2000 J/KG. CONVECTIVE COVERAGE SHOULD CONTINUE INCREASING THROUGHOUT THE EARLY AFTERNOON ACROSS CNTRL/ERN OH...WITH A QUICK EVOLUTION INTO CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS PRIOR TO UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A LIKELY MCS. CONVECTION PERSISTING ACROSS WRN PA AND NERN WV HAS RESULTED IN EFFECTIVE BAROCLINIC ZONE FROM E-CNTRL OH INTO NRN WV...BUT CLEARING/SUBSIDENCE IN THE WAKE OF ONGOING CONVECTION SHOULD ALLOW FOR AT LEAST PARTIAL AIR MASS RECOVERY. PRIMARY THREAT IS LIKELY TO BE DMGG WIND GUSTS WITH EVOLVING CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...BUT ISOLATED LARGE HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE. MODERATELY STRONG WLY LOW-MIDLEVEL FLOW WAS OBSERVED IN PBZ/CLE VWP DATA...AND VEERING WITHIN THE LOWEST 1 KM AGL MAY SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR A TORNADO OR TWO...PARTICULARLY WHILE CONVECTION REMAINS MORE DISCRETE. TRENDS ARE BEING CLOSELY MONITORED FOR ISSUANCE OF A WW...LIKELY BY 18-19Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR WIDESPREAD STRONG TO DMGG WIND GUSTS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY INCREASE ACROSS WRN PORTIONS OF WW 261. A LOCALIZED SHORT-TERM TORNADO THREAT MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY A PAIR OF DISCRETE STORMS ACROSS FAR ERN WV AND NRN VA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR TRENDS CONTINUE TO SHOW AN INCREASE IN CONVECTION CROSSING THE UPPER OH VALLEY...WITH SEVERAL MERGERS RESULTING IN A GRADUALLY ORGANIZING CONVECTIVE LINE APPROACHING THE APPALACHIANS OF WV AND SRN PA. MOST FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUSTAINING STRONG TO SVR CONVECTION REMAINS ALONG/S OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND EFFECTIVE STATIONARY FRONT ACROSS SWRN PA INTO NRN MD/VA...WHERE STRONG HEATING AMIDST RELATIVELY RICH BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE IS YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES GENERALLY BETWEEN 1000-1500 J/KG. STRONG TO DMGG WIND AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EWD THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EARLY EVENING. ALSO OF NOTE...A COUPLE OF DISCRETE TSTMS OVER FAR ERN WV MOVING TOWARDS NRN VA APPEAR TO BE ANCHORED ALONG/NEAR THE AFOREMENTIONED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/FRONT. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS GENERALLY WEAK ACROSS THE REGION...BUT ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL VORTICITY IN THE VICINITY OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY COULD PROVIDE AN INCREASED SHORT-TERM LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLE TORNADO THREAT. ..ROGERS.. 06/16/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL PERSIST MAINLY FROM ERN WV THROUGH WRN AND NRN VA WITH THREAT SOMEWHAT MORE MARGINAL IN SERN PA AND WITH ERN EXTENT INTO MD. A TORNADO OR TWO REMAINS POSSIBLE MAINLY WITH MORE DISCRETE CELLS OVER NRN VA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS EVENING A LINE OF STORMS ACROSS ERN WV IS MOVING SEWD AT AROUND 35 KT. OTHER MORE DISCRETE CELLS REMAIN OVER NRN VA. THE DOWNSTREAM ATMOSPHERE IS MODERATELY UNSTABLE OVER MUCH OF VA WITH 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE ALONG WITH 40-45 KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. A ZONE OF DEEPER ASCENT DOWNSTREAM FROM A SEWD-MOVING SHORTWAVE TROUGH ALONG WITH CONVERGENCE ALONG THE LEADING GUST FRONT SHOULD HELP TO SUSTAIN STORMS THROUGH WRN AND NRN/CNTRL VA NEXT COUPLE HOURS. A CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED BOUNDARY WAS OBSERVED ON VIS IMAGERY MOVING WWD THROUGH NRN VA. WINDS HAVE VEERED TO SELY EAST OF THIS BOUNDARY WHERE AT LEAST MODEST INSTABILITY REMAINS IN PLACE. DISCRETE STORMS INTERACTING WITH AND CROSSING INTO THE SLIGHTLY COOLER SIDE OF THIS BOUNDARY MAY POSE A RISK FOR A TORNADO OR TWO DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. OTHERWISE...THREAT APPEARS TO BE LIMITED IN SRN PA WHERE THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS MORE STABLE...RESULTING IN AN OVERALL WEAKENING OF STORMS. ..DIAL.. 06/16/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD GRADUALLY DEVELOP OVER THE NORTHERN PLAINS THIS EVENING. SOME OF THESE CELLS MAY BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR POTENTIAL WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE OF HIGH-BASED CONVECTIVE CELLS HAVE DEVELOPED NORTHEAST OF THE BLACK HILLS THIS EVENING...IN RESPONSE TO ONGOING LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG A STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDING WESTWARD INTO NORTHEAST WY. WHILE THESE CELLS ARE IN AN ENVIRONMENT OF FAIRLY MEAGER MOISTURE...RICHER SFC DEW POINTS /UPPER 60S - LOWER 70S/ EXIST FARTHER NORTHEAST ACROSS FAR NORTHERN SD AND CENTRAL ND. ON THE FRINGE OF A WESTERN-CONUS TROUGH...MODEST MID-LEVEL FORCING FOR ASCENT AND ONGOING SFC CONVERGENCE ALONG A TROUGH ARE ENCOURAGING THE GRADUAL GROWTH OF A CU FIELD OVER THIS AREA. AND OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...ISOLATED/WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS MAY DEVELOP. IN COMBINATION WITH RELATIVELY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...AMPLE SFC HEATING AND LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ARE YIELDING AROUND 2000-3500 J/KG OF MLCAPE OVER CENTRAL/SOUTHERN ND. WHILE EVEN HIGHER VALUES EXIST FARTHER SOUTH...THE STRONGEST MID-LEVEL FLOW AND FORCING FOR ASCENT ARE LOCATED ACROSS WESTERN/NORTHERN ND. NONETHELESS...A FEW DEVELOPING CELLS MAY BE ABLE TO ACQUIRE SUPERCELLULAR CHARACTERISTICS THIS EVENING AND SUCH CELLS WOULD BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. THE GREATEST SEVERE POTENTIAL LIKELY WILL EXIST OVER SOUTHERN/CENTRAL ND...WHERE A FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT OVERLAPS STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW AND FORCING FOR ASCENT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR POTENTIAL WATCH ISSUANCE THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS OVER ECNTRL VA ARE EXPECTED TO REMAIN THE MOST ORGANIZED AND PERSISTENT...AND THESE ARE MOVING INTO WW 262. STORMS CROSSING INTO WRN MD SHOULD BEGIN TO WEAKEN AFTER 02Z AS THEY MOVE INTO A MORE STABLE REGIME. STORMS MOVING INTO SWRN VA MAY CONTINUE TO POSE SOME RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL FOR 1-2 HOURS BEYOND 02Z...AND WW CAN BE LOCALLY EXTENDED FARTHER SOUTH INTO RNK CWA IF NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 00Z RAOB FROM RNK INDICATES A MARGINALLY UNSTABLE ATMOSPHERE WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES IN THE SFC-700 MB LAYER ALONG WITH 40-50 KT WNWLY WINDS IN THE 700-500 MB LAYER. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A THREAT FOR A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS NEXT COUPLE HOURS...BUT STORMS CROSSING INTO THIS REGIME MAY BEGIN TO EXPERIENCE DOWNSLOPE EFFECTS WHICH COMBINED WITH A STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD RESULT IN A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND BY 03-04Z. FARTHER NORTH...THE STORMS CROSSING INTO MD FROM NERN VA MAY REMAIN CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS NEXT HOUR OR SO...BUT SHOULD GRADUALLY WEAKEN AS THEY MOVE FARTHER INTO MD AND DEEPER INTO A MORE STABLE REGIME. OTHERWISE...THE STRONGEST AND MOST PERSISTENT STORMS MOVING SEWD THROUGH ECNTRL VA SHOULD REMAIN CONTAINED IN WW 262 NEXT COUPLE HOURS. ..DIAL.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY POSE A RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AS THEY MOVE SEWD INTO NERN NC THROUGH 05Z. DUE TO THE EXPECTED LIMITED DURATION AND AREAL EXTENT OF THE THREAT...A WW WILL PROBABLY NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BROKEN LINE OF STORMS OVER SERN VA IS MOVING SEWD AT 35-40 KT. THE DOWNSTREAM ATMOSPHERE OVER NERN NC REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE. THE SFC LAYER HAS STABILIZED...AND TEMPERATURES HAVE FALLEN INTO THE LOW 70S. HOWEVER...PRESENCE OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH ONLY A WEAK NEAR-SFC INVERSION SUGGEST STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG SWD SURGING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY NEXT COUPLE HOURS. ACTIVITY IS EMBEDDED WITHIN 25-40 KT WINDS IN THE 700-500 MB LAYER...AND UP TO 40 KT SPEED OF MOTION OF THE LINE SUGGEST WINDS COULD APPROACH SEVERE LEVELS ON AN ISOLATED BASIS NEXT HOUR OR TWO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY INCREASE AS ELEVATED STORMS ACROSS SOUTHEAST MT SPREAD NORTHEAST INTO WESTERN ND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDELY SCATTERED ELEVATED STORMS ARE ONGOING OVER SOUTHEAST MT. PER RAP-PARALLEL SOUNDINGS...THIS ACTIVITY IS LIKELY ROOTED AROUND 700-MB ON THE FRINGE OF MEAGER MUCAPE. A RATHER LARGE GRADIENT IN MUCAPE LIKELY EXISTS DOWNSTREAM ACROSS THE WESTERN DAKOTAS IN THE WAKE OF A SURFACE COLD FRONT AS MODERATELY LARGE BUOYANCY PERSISTS IN THE WARM SECTOR OVER THE CENTRAL DAKOTAS AMID UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS. GUIDANCE IS CONSISTENT IN THE SURFACE FRONT SLIDING SOUTHEAST THIS MORNING WITH NEGATIVE THETA-E ADVECTION AT 850-MB INCREASING ACROSS THE WESTERN DAKOTAS. THIS SUGGESTS THAT THE MUCAPE GRADIENT WILL ACCORDINGLY SHIFT IN A SIMILAR MANNER. AS SUCH...STORMS OVER SOUTHEAST MT MAY REMAIN RATHER ELEVATED AND NOT BECOME ESTABLISHED INTO THE LARGER BUOYANCY. REGARDLESS...HRRR-PARALLEL SIMULATIONS ARE QUITE INSISTENT ON STRENGTHENING UPDRAFT HELICITY WITH THIS ACTIVITY AS IT SPREADS INTO WESTERN ND. SHOULD UPDRAFT ROTATION OCCUR...PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL...BUT STRONG WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE AS WELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SHORT QLCS ACROSS SOUTHWEST ND SHOULD CONTINUE TO POSE A RISK FOR SEVERE WIND/HAIL AS IT PROGRESSES TOWARDS THE BISMARCK AREA. DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE INTO EASTERN ND MAY BECOME NECESSARY BY 10Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEADING EDGE OF AN INTENSE SHORT-LINE SEGMENT RUNS FROM MERCER TO GRANT COUNTIES AS OF 0815Z. BASED ON INBOUND VELOCITY SIGNATURES EXCEEDING 50 KT AND MRMS MESH DATA DEPICTING EMBEDDED 1.0-1.5 INCH DIAMETER HAIL...A SWATH OF SEVERE WIND-DRIVEN LARGE HAIL APPEARS PROBABLE /ESPECIALLY ALONG A DEVELOPING BOW STRUCTURE IN WESTERN MORTON COUNTY/. WHILE THIS ACTIVITY IS ROOTED BY ELEVATED PARCELS...IT IS APPROACHING THE SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT THAT IS LIKELY JUST EAST OF BISMARCK BASED ON 08Z SURFACE OBSERVATIONS. POTENTIAL ACCELERATION OF FORWARD PROPAGATION MAY RESULT IN THIS LINE SEGMENT CROSSING THE WARM SECTOR IN SOUTHEAST ND. THIS MAY SUSTAIN A RISK FOR SEVERE WIND/HAIL CONTINUING AFTER SUNRISE. ..GRAMS.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WHILE THE SEVERE THREAT HAS LIKELY PEAKED...ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL POTENTIAL MAY PERSIST EAST OF WW 263 INTO MID-MORNING. PROBABILITY OF DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE IS 30 PERCENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LONG-LIVED CLUSTER WITH AN EMBEDDED SUPERCELL WHICH HAD PRODUCED MEASURED SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND SIGNIFICANT SEVERE HAIL IN THE BISMARCK AREA IS IN THE PROCESS OF MERGING WITH WAA-DRIVEN STORMS AROUND 30 MILES WEST OF THE SURFACE COLD FRONT. THIS CONSOLIDATION MAY YIELD A NEAR-TERM INCREASE IN EASTWARD ACCELERATION OF THE CLUSTER ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL ND ALONG THE NORTHERN PERIPHERY OF THE INSTABILITY AXIS. AS ACTIVITY PROGRESSES TOWARDS THE RED RIVER VALLEY AND DEPARTS 66-68 DEGREE F SURFACE DEW POINTS...THIS CLUSTER SHOULD WEAKEN. THE 00Z CAMS WHICH REASONABLY SIMULATED THIS EARLY MORNING CLUSTER /SUCH AS THE NSSL-WRF/ GENERALLY SUGGEST A DECREASE IN SIMULATED REFLECTIVITY/UPDRAFT HELICITY BETWEEN 12-15Z. ..GRAMS.. 06/17/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
